children.name: Intro
children.text: Optics colors come in two layers. Primitives are the palette; Semantic tokens say what a color is for (a surface, critical text, the focus ring) and change with Light and Dark. Designs only use Semantic tokens.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Text styles combine a font, size, weight, line height and letter spacing. Headings title pages and sections; body styles carry text and controls. Optics uses Inter.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Spacing is a 4px grid. A step’s name is in hundredths of 4px: space/100 is 4px, space/400 is 16px. Use it for padding and gaps.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Corner radii, from square to fully round. Controls use radius/200; cards radius/300; dialogs radius/400.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Shadows lift surfaces off the page: shadow/100 for cards, 300 for menus and tooltips, 600 for dialogs. Dark mode uses darker shadows, so they still show.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Durations and easing curves for transitions. Small changes are fast; big movements take longer. Respect reduced motion: skip movement, keep the change.

children.name: Intro
children.text: Optics Icons is the whole Lucide set from Sigma Icons: 1,877 outline icons, 24px with a 2px stroke, colored with the icon tokens. Here are some from each group; open Optics Icons to see and search them all. Pick icons people already know, and name icon-only controls for screen readers.
